job_template:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  namespace: fs2-academic-poc
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: fs2-serve
    kueue.x-k8s.io/queue-name: academic-scientific
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: fs2-academic-runner
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      restartPolicy: Never
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        supplementalGroups: [65532]
      volumes:
        - name: academic-assets
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: academic-assets-runtime-rwx
            readOnly: true
      containers:
        - name: scientific
          volumeMounts:
            - name: academic-assets
              mountPath: /models/af3.bin.zst
              subPath: alphafold3/af3.bin.zst
              readOnly: true
            - name: academic-assets
              mountPath: /opt/fs2/academic/pyrosetta-bindcraft/site-packages
              subPath: scientific-localization/private/generations/bindcraft-pyrosetta-installed-tree/sha256/a93d68e198c81cbb87926e012dff6b50a73e99d9a41261e65f73d264c792aa8d
              readOnly: true
